No TTL reset or echo loop.\n            if (!root || root.Emitters.Find(actor.Entity) >= 0)\n                return;\n            if (!HCInfectedPolicy.MayRelay(now, root.RootObserved, root.RootExpires, actor.Heard.Hops, actor.Heard.Strength, true, true))\n                return;\n            hops = actor.Heard.Hops;\n            strength = actor.Heard.Strength;\n        }\n     root.Emitters.Insert(actor.Entity);\n        m_Queue.Insert(emission);\n    }\n\n    protected bool ClearGeometry(vector origin, ZombieBase emitter, ZombieBase recipient)\n    {\n        vector + "0 1.4 0", point, contact, normal, component, hits, null, emitter, true, false, ObjIntersectView);\n        if (!hit || hits.Count() == 0 || hits[0] != recipient)\n            return false;\n && hits[0] == recipient;\n    }\n\n    int Step(array<ref HCInfectedActor> actors, float now, int work)\n    {\n        Expire(now);\n        int spent = 0;\n        // One bounded tracked recipient per work item, up to two geometry tests.\n        // No GetPlayers/global entity enumeration or unbounded spatial result.\n        while (spent < work && m_Queue.Count() > 0)\n        {\n            spent++;\n            HCAlertEmission emission = m_Queue[0];\n            if (!emission.Emitter || !emission.Emitter.IsAlive() || emission.Cursor >= actors.Count() || emission.Root.Recipients.Count() >= 12)\n            {\n                m_Queue.Remove(0);\n                continue;\n            }\n            HCInfectedActor actor = actors[emission.Cursor++];\n            if (!actor.Entity || emission.Emitter, actor.Entity);\n            if (!HCInfectedPolicy.MayHearRelay(now, emission.Root.RootExpires, emission.Clue.Hops, emission.Clue.Strength, distanceSq, emission.Clue;\n            actor.HeardRootId = emission.Root.RootId;\n            actor.HeardExternally = true;\n            actor.SearchAttempts = 0;\n            actor.Clue = emission.Clue;\n
